$comment: Gap ids a ref's gaps.json may reuse, so the clustering counts one gap across refs. A seed, not a limit: a gap that is not here gets its own kebab-case id, and `pnpm eval:refs -- --vocab` lists every id already in use. Reuse before minting. A prediction is not a finding: log a gap only when the rebuild hit it.

ids.summary: Space between page sections larger than the spacing scale's top step.
Display or hero text larger than the top of the type ramp.
Tighter (negative) letter spacing on large display text than the ramp allows.
Corner radius larger than the radius scale (cards or media at 16px and up).
A second, supporting accent hue beside the one accent.
A tinted (non-neutral) surface or panel fill.
A big-number tile: value, label, change or trend.
A small inline trend chart beside a value or in a row.
A card led by a cover image or illustration.
A full-bleed image or media band behind or beside a headline.
An icon set inside a filled square or circle as a visual anchor.
A scrolling row of filter chips above a list or grid.
A phone bottom navigation bar with icons and labels.
A thumb-reachable bar of primary actions pinned to the bottom of a phone screen.
The label-value lockup (hirobius/hds#520), shared with the explorations gap ids.
Table rows denser than the row size tokens allow.
A gradient fill, which DESIGN.md rules out.
A frosted or translucent surface, which DESIGN.md rules out.
